texts.zh:
一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新激活了。这件事关系到我们先前在[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]开展的行动，似乎是某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报。

信息细节上很含糊，但是这段代码携带了关于一个外星帝国关键政治人物情报的标记。

我方安全顾问确认这套代码不久前仍然可用，但代码的到期意味着外国势力介入的可能。况且我们也没有证据表明特工或是信息本身的是真是假。
texts.en:
A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.

The message is light on details, but the code carries markers which signify intelligence on key political figures in a foreign empire.

Our security advisors confirm that the codes were valid until quite recently, but their expiry means such codes are open to compromise by foreign powers. There's no telling if the operative or their message are genuine.

texts.zh:
一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新激活了。这件事关系到我们先前在[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]开展的行动，似乎是某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报。

信息细节上很含糊，但是这段代码携带了关于一个外星帝国关键政治人物情报的标记。

该情报人员已被宣告失联，安全顾问建议我们应当慎重考量。废弃的代码和甚至可能已经不知所踪的特工——我们应当假设其已经叛变。
texts.en:
A long-expired set of covert codes has just been re-activated. They are linked to Operations we previously carried out in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], from where it would seem a former operative is trying to report back in.

The message is light on details, but the code carries markers which signify intelligence on key political figures in a foreign empire.

The operative had been declared lost, and as such our security advisors advise extreme caution. Expired codes - and perhaps even lost operatives - are assumed to be already compromised.

label.zh: 前代理已被除名，将其忽略。
label.en: Former agents are to be disavowed. Ignore this.

texts.zh: 我们又收到了一段来自[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]境内的加密信息，这次采用了另一套加密。如我们料想的一样，一度失联的特工声称他们所持有的情报使他们处于极度危险之中。他们声称如果我们不采取行动救援的话，就会考虑叛变。
texts.en: We've received another encrypted message from within the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], employing a different cipher this time. Our supposed, once-lost operative claims that the knowledge they hold puts their life at extreme risk. They say that if we do not extract and debrief them, they must consider defecting.

label.zh: 空洞而可疑的威胁，继续忽略。
label.en: An empty and suspicious threat. Continue to ignore.

label.zh: 好吧。准备一支救援小队。

texts.zh:
[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]境内再也没有收到我们的那位除名特工发来的消息了。我们认为这个问题已经被解决了。

我们也许永远也不会知道是否真的有一位前特工存在，也不会知道他是否真的持有有用的情报。如果这确系[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]的阴谋的话，我们可以放心地说：他们的诡计失败了。
texts.en:
There have been no further messages from our disavowed operative within the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. The matter is being considered as resolved.

We may never know if there really was a former operative - nor will we know if there actually was useful intelligence to be had. If this was instead a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ruse: we can safely state that their ploy has failed.

texts.zh:
我们收到了一份来自[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]由[disavowed_agent_official.GetName]发出的非常愤怒的公告，宣称有个人前来与[disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap]接触，却又表明自己曾是[root.GetAdj]间谍。[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]代表不过只言片语，却强烈表明了他们对于“异国特工”的忍无可忍。

如果这条信息属实，可能那位除名特工已经遭遇不测了。不管怎样，这件事都连带造成了些许外交结果。
texts.en:
We have received a rather brusk communiqué from [disavowed_agent_official.GetName] of the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. [disavowed_agent_official.GetHeSheCap] claim[disavowed_agent_official.GetSXX] to have been approached by someone who had, in turn, identified themself as a former [root.GetAdj] spy. The [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] representative used few words, but keenly expressed their empire's narrow tolerance for 'foreign agents'.

If any part of this message is to be believed, it is likely the disavowed operative has met a fatal end. Either way: this matter carries some diplomatic consequences.

texts.zh:
我们从[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]收到了一份出离愤怒的声明。他们宣称受到了一位前[root.GetAdj]间谍的渗透，我们应该对此负责。此外，此人将会依据他们对“境外间谍”的相关政策受到一切可能的刑罚。

如果这条信息属实，可能那位除名特工已经遭遇不测了。不管怎样，这件事都连带造成了些许外交结果。
texts.en:
We have received a rather brusk statement from the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. They claim to have been approached by a former [root.GetAdj] spy, and that we are to be held to account. Furthermore, this individual is set to suffer every punishment their society has set for 'foreign agents'.

If any part of this message is to be believed, it is likely the disavowed operative has met a fatal end. Either way: this matter carries some diplomatic consequences.

texts.zh:
我们收到来自[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的一篇不寻常的通报，他们宣称已经被[root.GetAdj]前特工渗透。如果属实，那这位除名特工确实存在，并且已经迫于压力而背叛——他所面临的则是被[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]政府彻底消灭。通报是这么写的。

[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]并没有清楚表明他们的下一步动向，但这样的人如果他还留在原处，必然还会被安置在层层监视之下。依照国际惯例，[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]已经因为这起“侵犯主权领域”事件签署了针对我们的外交制裁。
texts.en:
We have received an unusual statement from the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName], claiming they have been approached by a former [root.GetAdj] spy. If the message is to be believed, the disavowed operative not only exists, but felt no recourse other than to defect - only to be dismissed outright by [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] authorities. Or so the message claims.

The [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] do not state precisely what their next course of action will be, but such an individual would almost certainly be placed under close observation for as long as they remain there. As a formality, the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] have issued a diplomatic sanction against us for this 'violation of sovereign territory'.

texts.zh:
我方安全顾问报告称我们在[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的前特工可能造成的威胁已经被全部扫清。一支精挑细选的特遣队确认了此个体的真实存在，并迅速将其消灭。然而没人能确定该个体真是我们的特工，还是[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]诡计的一部分。

不管怎样，这名特工和其声称所持有的情报现已不会被任何帝国知晓了。
texts.en:
Our security advisors report an end to any threat which may have been posed by our former operative in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. A specially-chosen task force was able to confirm the existence of this individual - before swiftly ending it. However, no one can be certain if this was a genuine operative, or part of a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ploy.

Either way: both the operative's existence and the information they claimed to hold have now been put safely beyond the reach of either empire.

texts.zh:
位于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]境内试图重新取得联系的前特工已经被悉数处理干净。一支精挑细选的特遣队确认了此个体的真实存在，并迅速将其消灭。然而没人能确定该个体真是我们的特工，还是[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]诡计的一部分。

不管怎样，这名特工和其声称所持有的情报现已不会被任何帝国知晓了。
texts.en:
The former operative who had attempted to regain contact from within the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] has been cleanly dealt with. A specially-chosen task force was able to confirm the existence of this individual - before swiftly ending it. However, no one can be certain if this was a genuine operative, or part of a [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] ploy.

Either way: both the operative's existence and the information they claimed to hold have now been put safely beyond the reach of either empire.

texts.zh:
我们一度被除名的特工自行设法回到了[root.GetAdj]境内。这名[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]个体——称[disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself]自己为[disavowed_operative.GetName]——又紧张又如释重负，但好在还是通过了全部安全验证。任务简报中报告的行动显得尤为艰难，但其中的信息被证明相当有用——我们现在能获取一位能干的线人。

由于事态已经解决，[disavowed_operative.GetName]悬而未决的除名流程现在被更新。确认了[disavowed_operative.GetHeShe]没有在行动中失踪之后，我们现役的特工确信这次除名不再生效。
texts.en:
Our once-disavowed operative has made it back to [root.GetAdj] space. This [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] individual - who identified [disavowed_operative.GetHimselfHerself] as [disavowed_operative.GetName] - appears nervous and relieved, but has cleared all security verification. The debriefing has been described as arduous, but the information has proven to be useful - we have now gained access to a valuable Asset.

With the matter now resolved, [disavowed_operative.GetName]'s shaky disavowal will be renewed. Having confirmed that [disavowed_operative.GetHeShe] [disavowed_operative.GetIsAre] no longer missing in action, our current operatives can ensure that this time, the disavowal will stick.

texts.zh:
我们派遣到[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的秘密强袭小队匆匆返回了。我们的小队发现似乎其实并没有什么除名的特工。取而代之的，小队从蛛丝马迹中发现这一切都是为了暴露我们的秘密行动而设下的全套。

也许这是为了进一步实现[disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj]目标的计划；又或者是另一个外部势力正在介入其中。但无论如何：我们都要及时终止遏制措施以避免暴露我们一直以来的情报活动。
texts.en:
The clandestine strike team we sent into the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] have returned with great haste. It seems there never was a disavowed operative. Instead what the team found was subtle evidence of a plot to expose our clandestine operations.

Perhaps this was a scheme intended to further [disavowed_agent_country.GetAdj] goals; perhaps an external body sought to meddle in our affairs. In either case: our containment measures were aborted just in time to avoid exposing our intelligence operations, past or present.

texts.zh:
看来我们在追寻想要的被除名特工时太过着急了。被我们派往[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的特勤小队现已完全失联。我们现在怀疑所谓的特工并不存在。

所有参与该行动的特工现均被除名。因此，由于间谍网亟待恢复，我们于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]进行长远行动的能力在近期将被削弱。
texts.en:
It appears we acted too hastily in trying to extract our supposed, disavowed operative. We have entirely lost contact with the team of operatives we dispatched to the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName]. We now suspect that the operative never existed.

All operatives who were associated with this endeavor have been disavowed. As a result, our ability to conduct further operations in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] will be restricted for a time as the Spy Network recovers.

一套早已过期的秘密代码刚刚被重新传送到了我方，这涉及到我们在[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]已经开展的行动。

某个我们曾经除名的情报人员正试图汇报，此人宣称携带了关于一个位于[disavowed_agent_country.GetName]的关键政治人物情报的标记——但是，这些早已作废的代码能够信任吗？
texts.en:
A long-expired set of covert codes has been re-transmitted to us, linked to Operations we previously carried out in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName].

A once-disavowed operative is apparently trying to report back in, claiming to possess intelligence on key political figures in the [disavowed_agent_country.GetName] - but can these expired codes be trusted?

某些位于[vividsight_country.GetName]听从我们指令的特工开始引起不必要的注意——他们某种程度上成为了……红人？

我们没有理由相信他们的身份暴露了，但是他们不断增长的名声和影响力让我们在隐蔽间谍网方面愈发紧张兮兮。
texts.en:
Some of the operatives we control in the [vividsight_country.GetName] are beginning to draw unusual amounts of attention; they are regarded as somehow... attractive?

We have no reason to believe their cover identities are in jeopardy, but their growing notoriety and influence put strain on the deniability of our Spy Network.

[finderskeepers_country.GetAdj]加密密钥的一部分落入了位于[finderskeepers_country.GetName]的一名格外眼尖的特工[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。看起来是某位粗心的[finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName]政客在通勤时落下了这一设备。

这对于我们在[finderskeepers_country.GetName]中的行动而言是个好兆头，而且就这一设备独特设计的研究揭示了若干有助于我们通用破译方法研发的新颖洞见。
texts.en:
A particularly observant operative in the [finderskeepers_country.GetName] has laid their [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] on part of a [finderskeepers_country.GetAdj] encryption key. It would seem a careless [finderskeepers_country.GetSpeciesName] Politician mislaid the device whilst commuting.

This bodes well enough for our operations in the [finderskeepers_country.GetName], but our study of the device's unique design has revealed novel insights for our general approach to Codebreaking.

我们在[capital_scope.GetName]的一名政客一时大意，将一组敏感材料放错了位置，其中包括一个即使只是单纯将其带出政府机关外也已经严重违反协议的加密密钥。

我国内政部门正在抢救式切换安保平台，因为这些材料很可能已经落入敌对势力[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
texts.en:
One of our Politicians on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an encryption key whose very existence outside of government facilities is a gross breach of protocol.

Our domestic authorities are scrambling to switch security platforms, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into hostile [root.species.GetHandNamePlural].

texts.zh:
我们在[capital_scope.GetName]的一名[root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural]一时大意，将一组敏感材料放错了位置，其中包括一个即使只是单纯将其带出政府机关外也已经严重违反协议的加密密钥。

我方安全团队正在抢救式切换安保平台，因为这些材料很可能已经落入我们的竞争者[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]中。
texts.en:
One of our [root.GetCorpRulerJobPlural] on [capital_scope.GetName] has carelessly misplaced a bundle of sensitive materials, including an encryption key whose mere existence outside of strictly-defined zones is a gross breach of protocol.

Our security teams are scrambling to switch operating procedures, as it's quite possible these materials may have fallen into the [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] of our competitors.

我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工发现了一些不寻常的事情：有可靠线索表明，[insidious_plot_country.GetName]正阴谋欺骗我方！我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。

虽然完全不清楚[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]是如何获知这些情报的。不过我们的特工追踪可疑的[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj]特工的努力似乎已经有了回报。但如果这些情报是真的，[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]可能只是艰辛地为我们收集了该情报。
texts.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered something unusual: credible hints that the [insidious_plot_country.GetName] are plotting to deceive us! We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.

Quite how this information came to be known by the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] is unclear. Our own operatives' efforts to tail suspected [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj] intelligence operatives seem to have paid off, though. If this intelligence is genuine, the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] may just have done the hard work of gathering it for us.

texts.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工揭露了一些谣言——[insidious_plot_country.GetName]正在密谋欺骗我们。我们尚不掌握这一可疑的计划的具体细节，但据称其中包括对我们以及我们的生活方式本身的破坏。

虽然完全不清楚[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]是如何获知这些情报的。不过我们的特工追踪可疑的[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj]特工的努力似乎已经有了回报。但如果这些情报是真的，[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName]可能只是艰辛地为我们收集了该情报。
texts.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered rumors that the [insidious_plot_country.GetName] are plotting to deceive us. We have no exact details of their apparent scheme yet, but it seems set to try and undermine us and our way of life.

Quite how this information came to be known by the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] is unclear. Our own operatives' efforts to tail suspected [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetAdj] intelligence operatives seem to have paid off, though. If this intelligence is genuine, the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetSpeciesName] may just have done the hard work of gathering it for us.

texts.zh:
我们在[insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName]的特工获悉了一些可靠的传闻，当地有针对我们的阴谋。似乎他们[insidious_plot_country.GetAdj]特工对于自身特工行为的保密性不太重视。

我们尚未掌握该暴露阴谋的具体细节，但据说其中涉及对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。
texts.en:
Our operatives in the [insidious_plot_spynetwork.GetName] have uncovered credible rumors of a local plot against us. It seems their [insidious_plot_country.GetAdj] counterparts are somewhat careless about their own operational secrecy.

We have no exact details for their apparent scheme yet, but it's said to involve a manipulation of our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life.

texts.zh:
我们被牵连进了一个针对[from.GetName]的阴谋中。这一指控是如此地含糊，以至于我们靠自己根本无从得知他们是否真的掌握了我们的把柄。

我们自己的间谍抗议说，这一指控毫无根据，声称这可能是我们目标之一的防御性、反间谍行动，抑或是来自第三方的抹黑。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。
texts.en:
We have been implicated in a plot against the [from.GetName]. So vague is the allegation that we cannot definitively state whether or not they are on to something.

Our own spies protest that the allegation is baseless, claiming this is likely either a defensive, counter-espionage response from one of our targets - or else a smear campaign being conducted by some third party. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

texts.zh:
令人惊讶的是，我们被毫无来由地指控参与到针对[from.GetName]的阴谋中。这一指控十分荒谬，因为我们近来委实未曾发起对外的间谍活动——但另一方面，[from.GetAdj]根本不知道这一指控有多荒谬。

似乎不明身份的人在试图陷害我们，从而为他们自己的不轨行为开脱——抑或是单纯为了制造外交混乱。但无论原因是什么，[from.GetName]都已经生气了。
texts.en:
Amazingly, we have been implicated in some vaguely-defined plot against the [from.GetName]. It's a ridiculous allegation, given our complete lack of foreign espionage activity so far - but then, the [from.GetAdj] would have no way of knowing how truly ridiculous the allegation is.

It would seem that parties unknown are attempting to frame us for their own misdemeanors - or perhaps simply to sow some diplomatic chaos. Whatever the reason or cause, the [from.GetName] have taken offense.

We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it looks to involve manipulating our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life. Spymaster [insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName] advises caution, however, as the ease by which we came across this information is fairly suspect.

尽管该计划的细节尚不得而知，但据说其中涉及对我们现有关系的操纵——即逐步摧毁信任协定和我们的生活方式本身。间谍首脑[insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName]建议对这一情况保持谨慎，因为这些信息的获得过于容易，显得相当可疑。

We have no exact details of the apparent scheme yet, but it looks to involve manipulating our existing relationships - undermining agreements of trust and our very way of life. Spymaster [insidious_plot_spymaster.GetName] advises caution, however, as the ease by which we came across this information is fairly suspect.

summary.text:
# 特工再次露面 / An Operative Resurfaces

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/nemesis_espionage_events.txt:399-460,488-1095,1214-1700,2214-2705`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每两年一次（on_bi_yearly_pulse_country）的 espionage.2：帝国有活跃的间谍网络时，随机抽取事件（见分支）。
  espionage.2 every two years (on_bi_yearly_pulse_country): while the empire has an active spy network it draws a random event (see branches).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1001「被弃特工重现」（先隐藏的1000，360天后）：无视 → 1005「固执的前特工」（再选三种应对，得到1011/1012/1013/1016/1017/1021/1022 之一）；救出 → 1021/1017/1022（64/18/18）。
  1001 "An Operative Resurfaces" (via hidden 1000, 360 days later): ignore -> 1005 "An Insistent Former Operative" (three responses leading to one of 1011/1012/1013/1016/1017/1021/1022); extract -> 1021/1017/1022 (64/18/18).
- 1030「隐于众目」（降低行动难度，仅格式塔）、1040「意外收获」（获得资产，需要宿敌）、1050「失物招领」（解密加成）、1060「游离的通讯」（加密降低）、1081「阴谋曝光」→ 1085「牵连其中」，1082「可疑阴谋」→ 1085。
  1030 "Hiding in Vivid Sight" (lower operation difficulty, gestalt only), 1040 "A Surprise Catch" (asset, needs a nemesis), 1050 "Finders Keepers" (decryption bonus), 1060 "Stray Communiqué" (lower encryption), 1081 "Insidious Plot Uncovered" -> 1085 "Implicated in a Plot", 1082 "Suspect Plot Uncovered" -> 1085.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 每次脉冲至多发生一个入口事件；被弃特工线内部结果互斥（见权重）。
  At most one entry per pulse; inside the disavowed-operative line outcomes are exclusive (see weights).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 1030 仅格式塔；1040 仅有宿敌；1000 需要目标国家曾被你的行动针对且不是杀戮或格式塔。
  1030 gestalt only; 1040 needs a nemesis; 1000 needs a target country your operation targeted that is neither homicidal nor gestalt.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：espionage.2 的权重与修正、1000 触发、1001 选项与延迟、1081/1082 来源。
  Checked: espionage.2 weights and modifiers, 1000 trigger, 1001 options and delays, sources of 1081/1082.
- 未逐条核对：1005–1022 内部选项的数值效果。
  Not checked line by line: the numeric effects inside the options of 1005-1022.
- r3-integrate（2026-10-13）：从抽取组中移除 espionage.1040（该文档位于 event-operation-2000/5000/5015 等行动故事中），权重说明保留在组注释里。
  r3-integrate (2026-10-13): Removed espionage.1040 from the draw group (that doc lives in the operation stories event-operation-2000/5000/5015); its weight is kept in the group note.
